bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 71
test "$(git -C "$root" remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#^https://github.com/##;s#^git@github.com:##;s#\\.git$##')" = "seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot" || exit 72
git -C "$root" fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/chat/bug-report-userbot-20261115
test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "a3e9babfaa3c4a7988d2cb38c52b3d3735a41f40" || exit 73
stage="$root/.worktrees/bug-report-dual-delivery-a3e9bab"
if test -e "$stage"; then
  test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "a3e9babfaa3c4a7988d2cb38c52b3d3735a41f40" || exit 74
  test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain)" || exit 75
else
  mkdir -p "$root/.worktrees"
  git -C "$root" worktree add --detach "$stage" FETCH_HEAD
fi
python3 -m py_compile "$stage/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$stage/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" "$stage/scripts/test_userbot_resident_ipc.py"
(cd "$stage/scripts" && python3 -m unittest test_userbot_resident_ipc -q)
docker build --pull=false -f "$stage/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bugdual-a3e9bab "$stage"
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bugdual-a3e9bab >/dev/null
printf 'BUG_REPORT_DUAL_STAGE_PASS\n'
